input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. Lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind swept pale lilac hood, ivory layered cloth with two narrow trailing lilac panels, silver wire charms and belt tools, slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Sparse wind wisps and tiny branching lightning. FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally TOWARD viewer and image RIGHT, face and front surfaces clearly visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate complete poses of ONE SAME character. Read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: four keys of a QUICK FLINCH AND RECOVERY: 1 ready upright pose; 2 sharp unmistakable recoil with shoulders and head pulled BACK by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; 3 shoulders returning and braced bent legs; 4 upright recovered ready pose. These four poses MUST visibly differ, not four standing duplicates. Row 2: first four keys of a BIGGER STAGGER: 5 upright ready; 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; 7 deepest backward bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; 8 lower body catches the weight, bent knees or legs. Row 3: 9 pushing back upright, visibly struggling; 10 upright recovered. Then begin COLLAPSE: 11 ready upright; 12 legs buckle and body drops. Row 4: continue COLLAPSE: 13 body very low, leaning toward ground; 14 torso falls sideways nearly horizontal; 15 body settles FULLY LYING on its side, head and entire torso on ground; 16 body completely still FULLY LYING ON GROUND, legs extended or naturally folded, equipment resting beside it. The final TWO poses must be completely horizontal resting bodies, never crouching, kneeling, sitting or getting back up. Treat collapse as a harmless theatrical fall/rest pose, fully intact. No blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. No attacker, impact flash or effects. Each of the 16 equal cells contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 65% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform solid vivid MAGENTA background (#FF00FF). Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is painting style only. Keep the exact same face, headwear, clothes, and single set of equipment: lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind swept pale lilac hood, ivory layered cloth robes with two narrow trailing lilac panels, silver wire charms and belt tools, slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Sparse wind wisps and tiny branching lightning. Isometric elevated 55-degree perspective, FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally toward viewer and image right, front surfaces clearly visible across all poses.

Arranged in an exact 4x4 grid (4 columns, 4 rows, 16 distinct pose frames total), read left to right, top to bottom, separated by wide solid magenta gutters:
Row 1 (Quick flinch and recovery): Pose 1 ready upright stance; Pose 2 sharp flinch recoil with shoulders and head pulled back by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; Pose 3 shoulders returning forward with braced bent legs; Pose 4 upright recovered ready stance.
Row 2 (Bigger stagger): Pose 5 upright ready; Pose 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; Pose 7 deepest backward stagger bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; Pose 8 lower body catches weight with deep bent knees.
Row 3 (Recovery & start of collapse): Pose 9 pushing back upright visibly struggling; Pose 10 upright recovered stance; Pose 11 ready upright; Pose 12 legs buckle and body drops down.
Row 4 (Collapse to lying): Pose 13 body very low, leaning close to ground; Pose 14 torso falling sideways nearly horizontal; Pose 15 body settles fully lying on its side, head and entire torso flat on the ground; Pose 16 body completely still fully lying horizontal on ground, legs extended or naturally folded, staff resting beside him.

Harmonious scale: each cell contains the entire body at identical anatomical scale fitting well within the middle 65% of each cell without clipping borders. Pure solid magenta background with no panel borders, no text, no ground texture, no floor, no blood or gore. Hand-painted digital dark fantasy illustration with sculpted painterly volume, smooth opaque paint, and cool upper-left lighting.
